## Audit Report: peruk12 Particle Task

**Finding:**
`machtzev/generator/specs-ds/peruk12.txt:16 · [מספר] particle references non-existent field "אגרת העברת בעלות משולמת לפני הרישום" which is not a defined תיק entity field · P0 compile-break/task not done · [מספר] requires valid field name; either add field to entity OR replace particle type with [תוכן קבוצה]`

**Coverage:**
Verified: spec file change applied correctly, generator ran without errors, compilation succeeded, no other specs impacted, particle-plan reflects unresolved state. Could not verify: particle never materialized in generated Dart (text search: 0 matches across gen_app_peruk12_*.dart and content files); particle excluded from case screens (px1/root show 6/6 valid particles, 1 failed); police text check failed `0×`.

The task is **NOT DONE** — the particle text does not appear in any generated output because [מספר] syntax requires the identifier after `[מספר]` to be a valid entity field, and "אגרת העברת בעלות משולמת לפני הרישום" is not a field in תיק entity schema.
